In the original, if you aim at them, the visor goes down. Not in the remake. If you shoot them, they flinch. Not in the remake. You can jump down ledges, and to get the companion down, you have to catch them for them to jump, doing so with the armour, in the original, plays a special animation where the main charcter falls to their knees from the weight, and does a ‘ouch my back’ animation after. In the remake, its the default 'light as air’ catch. There’s tons of other games I could bring up. As a child, those sorts of details in games was one of the things I deeply loved, and for a while, games had more and more of them, or so it felt like, but then the trend reversed, and now there’s much less of it, and it makes me a bit sad. Is there a behind the scenes reason beyond “change in focus”?
